en.answer: The effect of inflicting 1000 damage to your opponent will resolve normally.
en.question: If the effect of <<11662>> to inflict 1000 damage is activated in the Graveyard, but my opponent chains <<6980>> and banishes <<11662>>, how does its effect resolve?
